bundle.shortDescription: Suggests where files belong, finds duplicates and tidies folders with an undoable plan.
bundle.longDescription: File Organizer watches your everyday folders, suggests where new files belong, finds exact duplicates and turns a messy folder into an editable clean-up plan. Nothing moves without approval, nothing is deleted, and every run can be undone. Optional local AI runs fully offline.
